response.justification: Bogdan has extensive full-stack experience with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and AWS — aligning well with core requirements — but his seniority far exceeds the entry-level role, raising concerns about fit, retention, and cost, while his German language proficiency is minimal despite high on-site requirements.
strengths: Strong TypeScript and React experience across multiple production systems
Proven full-stack ownership from API to UI with scalable architecture focus
Active open-source contributions and deep interest in clean software practices
concerns: Overqualified for entry-level role; risk of quick turnover or misaligned expectations
Limited German proficiency despite high on-site presence requirement
Extensive experience with DLang and non-core tools may distract from platform priorities
